title: Jubilant Australian Marshmallow Pudding
description: A dense and festive Australian dessert featuring miniature marshmallows, perfect for special occasions. This lacto-vegetarian-friendly treat is made with yeast and dehydrated ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the oil, vanilla extract, and lactose-free milk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Fold in the dehydrated miniature marshmallows.
Transfer the dough to a Talavera plate and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the pudding from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the Jubilant Australian Marshmallow Pudding warm and enjoy.
